name: Glow Lab (personal)
subtitle: Your own build of THE GLOW LAB, signed with your Apple ID.
description: THE GLOW LAB is a local-first personal appearance, wardrobe, fitness and discovery platform. Everything is stored on the device; there is no account, no server and no subscription. This source serves the copy you built, so the records are yours alone.

apps.name: Glow Lab
apps.subtitle: Local-first appearance, wardrobe and training records.
apps.localizedDescription: Thirty departments over one local database: closet arithmetic and coverage, the week planner, fit sheets composed from photographs of your own garments, matched-framing progress sets, measurements, training logs, trend reads over the numbers you typed, and a discovery feed. Nothing is required to be online. Photos and measurements are private by default, and every optional behaviour sits behind a switch that ships off.

versions.whatsNew: Coverage matrix and the week planner, the closet glance on the dashboard, a training digest, per-department CSV export, a duplicate review queue, the untagged-piece tagging pass, a derailment record, and the N-shot same-framing capture set.
